title: Motor Burned Out After Only 9 Months of Use
text: Motor Burned Out After Only 9 Months of Use. I purchased this fan in October 2019, in July 2020, the motor overheated and it no longer works.  This is a lot of money to spend on a fan that doesn't even last a year.  When it was working, it worked great and I loved it.  But now, it's just money wasted.
